description: Source code for the AudioBiquadFilter class implementing a digital biquad filter with methods for configuration, processing, and state management within the Android audio framework.

classes.name: AudioBiquadFilter
classes.description: A class implementing a digital biquad filter for audio processing, supporting multiple channels and dynamic coefficient updates.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the filter with number of channels and sample rate.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the filter state and coefficients to default.

methods.name: setCoefs
methods.description: Sets target filter coefficients, optionally applying immediately.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes input audio samples through the filter.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the filter, optionally applying coefficients immediately.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the filter, optionally applying immediate bypass.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current processing state of the filter.

methods.name: updateCoefs
methods.description: Gradually updates filter coefficients towards target values based on max delta.
